resultText:
The change `add-meeting-room-bookings` is implemented, verified, reviewed once and archived (33 requirements merged into 4 specs). Nothing is committed.

- **Tasks:** T01–T28 all ticked, none open. The backend agent (`cr-nestjs-expert`) did T01–T16 and the frontend agent (`cr-nextjs-fe-developer`) did T17–T26 in parallel. The backend agent was interrupted once and resumed.
- **Verification (final run):** `pnpm run build` and `pnpm run lint` passed for all 7 projects. `pnpm run test` passed with 48 suites and 372 tests: backend-common 19, contract 17, booking 148, gateway 56, worker 23, room 11, web 98.
- **Integration specs:** they ran against the real Postgres, 4 tests in `backend-common` and 13 in `booking`, all passing. After the review fixes I did not repeat the dedicated integration command; the booking ones re-ran inside `pnpm run test`.
- **Review findings fixed (3), each with a failing test first:**
  - An oversized `page` (for example `1e30`) gave a 500; it now answers an empty page with the real total.
  - A NUL character in `title` gave a 500; it is now 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION` on create and update.
  - The edit dialog blocked a title-only save on a booking shorter than a minute; the span rule now skips an untouched stored start and end.
- **Review finding rejected (1):** dropping `idempotency_keys.created_at` as unread, because the Design section specifies that column. The R-13 note "every new column has a reader" in `change.md` is therefore inaccurate; I did not edit it.
- **Assumptions:**
  - `DELETE` answers `{ id }` over NATS, and `RECORD_CONFIRMATION` answers the stored booking.
  - The fingerprint compares `title` and `organizerEmail` case-sensitively.
  - The header check is an `@IdempotencyKey()` decorator, so it runs before body validation.
  - The web key hook issues a new key when the serialised payload differs.
  - The room filter and room select are native selects.
- **Files beyond the task lines:** three split backend spec files and five extra files in `apps/web/src/views/bookings/`, added to stay under 200 lines.
- **Open risks outside this change:**
  - `pnpm run test` needs Postgres whenever `.env` exists, because Nx injects `DB_HOST` and the integration specs do not skip.
  - The booking NATS handlers trust the gateway for title length and email format.
  - The gateway CORS does not expose `Idempotency-Replayed` to browsers.
- **Stack:** the postgres, redis and nats containers started by `scripts/stack-up.sh` are still running.
